components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; padding: 0.85rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #292E1E; color: #F4EEEB; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(41,46,30,.15), 0 8px 20px -8px rgba(41,46,30,.45); transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.3,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(41,46,30,.18), 0 14px 28px -10px rgba(41,46,30,.55); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B5842E; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Inverted Button
components.description: Used on dark (pine) backgrounds, e.g. the final CTA section.
components.css: .ds-btn-inverted { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; padding: 0.85rem 1.75rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #F4EEEB; color: #292E1E; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.1), 0 8px 20px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.35); transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.3,1), box-shadow 240ms cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.3,1); } .ds-btn-inverted:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 14px 28px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.4); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat, bordered content card used in the areas-of-care and why-Elora grids.
components.html:
Anxiety

Racing thoughts, tension, worry that doesn't let up.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FBF9F7; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, #B3A696 35%, transparent); border-radius: 16px; padding: 1.75rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #292E1E; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #7A6B5E; margin: 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #7A6B5E; font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14.5px; text-decoration: none; transition: color 140ms cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #292E1E; }

components.name: Underlined Link
components.description: Inline text link with a sweep-in underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-link-underline { position: relative; color: #292E1E; font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link-underline::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 100%; bottom: -2px; height: 1.5px; background: #B5842E; transition: right 240ms cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.3,1); } .ds-link-underline:hover::after { right: 0; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Small uppercase kicker above section headings.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #B5842E; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: Elora's system carries the brand's meaning — light and sun-ray, steady ground — as a feeling, never a statement. Every surface stays warm and grounded rather than clinical: cream and pine do the structural work, and a single gold accent appears only where it earns its place (an eyebrow label, a focus ring, a chevron). The system explicitly rejects anything overtly religious or floral, anything feminine-coded or sterile, and anything that reads as generic telehealth-startup gloss — no stock-photo hero, no app-download push, no cold institutional forms. Components feel warm and tactile: soft pill buttons with a settling lift on hover, flat bordered cards rather than heavy shadows, and motion that never rushes — fades and short rises only, always with a reduced-motion fallback.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral base (isabelline cream) with a single deep pine for text and primary actions
One gold accent (Warm Sun) used sparingly — eyebrows, focus rings, chevrons — never as a base color
Serif display (Cormorant Garamond) paired with a humanist sans (Karla) for warmth without sentimentality
Flat, bordered cards; shadow reserved for interactive elements only
Full-pill buttons, gentle settling motion, no bounce

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Warm Sun appears on labels, focus states, and small interactive marks only — never as a background fill or a large surface. If gold is covering more than a chevron or an underline, it's being overused.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Everything outside the uppercase label role — headings, buttons, nav — stays sentence case. No title case, no all-caps body copy.

rules.name: The Flat-Card Rule
rules.body: Cards never carry a shadow. A hairline border is the only separation a static surface gets; shadows are earned only by things the visitor can press.

dos: Do keep Warm Sun rare — labels, focus rings, chevrons, hover underlines only.
Do keep cards flat with a hairline border; reserve shadow for buttons and other pressable elements.
Do keep motion small and settling — fades and short rises at 140–420ms, cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.3,1), and always provide a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Do keep all copy in sentence case, including headings and buttons.
donts: Don't use religious or floral imagery — the light/growth motifs stay abstract (sun-ray, plant-vine), never literal or devotional.
Don't design anything that reads as feminine-coded or sterile/institutional — the brand is deliberately androgynous and warm, welcoming without assumptions.
Don't reach for generic telehealth-startup gloss (stock photography, app-download-first layouts, urgency banners) — Elora stays editorial and unhurried instead.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing anywhere; motion only settles, never overshoots.
Don't let Warm Sun cover a large surface — it is an accent, never a fill.
